# MS1Match ![](man/logo/MS1Match_Logo.png)

**MS1Match** is an R package for library-guided, compound-centric
feature grouping and annotation of LC-MS data (MS1 and MS2). It offers:

1.  Preprocessing of raw spectral data with the xcms framework
2.  Direct library-based annotation of detected features
3.  Annotation of adducts, isotopes, neutral losses and in-source MS2
    fragments, each with an evidence tier
4.  Targeted annotation based on a user-defined compound list
5.  Benchmarking of other feature-grouping tools (CAMERA, RAMClustR,
    MZmine, …) against the tier-stratified MS1Match reference set

# Overview

![MS1Match workflow: inputs, the four-step MS1Match pipeline producing
anno_result, and the optional evaluation of feature-grouping
tools](reference/figures/ms1match_overview.svg)

# Installation

## Requirements

- **R** `>= 4.5`, with the matching Bioconductor release
- **Rcpp**: required (the package contains compiled C++ code)
- **Build tools** to compile the C++ code:
  - **Windows:**
    [Rtools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) matching
    your R version (R 4.5.x → **Rtools45**)

  - **macOS:** Apple Command Line Tools

    ``` bash
    xcode-select --install
    ```

  - **Linux (Ubuntu/Debian):**

    ``` bash
    sudo apt update
    sudo apt install build-essential r-base-dev
    ```

``` r

install.packages("Rcpp")
```

## Bioconductor dependencies

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(
  c("xcms", "MSnbase", "Spectra", "MetaboCoreUtils",
    "MsExperiment", "MsBackendMgf", "BiocParallel", "S4Vectors"),
  ask = FALSE, update = TRUE
)
```

Optional, only for the tool comparisons in tutorial 3:

``` r

BiocManager::install("CAMERA")
install.packages("RAMClustR")
```

## Install MS1Match

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github("RuibingS/MS1Match_Rpackage",
                        build_vignettes = TRUE,
                        dependencies    = TRUE)
```

`build_vignettes = TRUE` knits the tutorials during installation, which
takes a few minutes. Leave it out for a faster install; the tutorials
are then not available offline with
[`vignette()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/vignette.html).

## Check the installation

``` r

library(MS1Match)
packageVersion("MS1Match")
browseVignettes("MS1Match")
```

## Troubleshooting

- **`Permission denied` on a `.dll` (Windows):** the package is loaded
  in an R session and its DLL is locked. Restart R (*Session → Restart
  R* in RStudio), close other R sessions, and install again before
  loading any package.
- **“… dependencies are out of date”:** a notice, not an error. To skip
  updating them, add `upgrade = "never"` to `install_github()`.
- **A Bioconductor package fails to install:** check that the R and
  Bioconductor versions match with
  [`BiocManager::valid()`](https://bioconductor.github.io/BiocManager/reference/valid.html).

# Using Docker

A Dockerfile is provided to run the package in a reproducible
environment without installing the dependencies manually.

### 1. Clone the repository

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/RuibingS/MS1Match_Rpackage.git
cd MS1Match_Rpackage
```

### 2. Build the Docker image

``` bash
docker build -t ms1match .
```

### 3. Run an interactive R session

``` bash
docker run -it --rm ms1match
```

- `-it` opens an interactive terminal for the R console
- `--rm` removes the container after you exit R
  ([`q()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/quit.html))

Inside the container:

``` r

library(MS1Match)
```

### Optional: mount a local folder

To work with files from your computer:

``` bash
docker run -it --rm -v "$(pwd)":/workspace ms1match
```

This mounts the current directory at `/workspace` inside the container.
On Windows (PowerShell), use `-v "${PWD}:/workspace"`.

# Tutorials

The tutorials follow the three steps of a typical analysis. Each one
starts from the output of the previous one, so you can enter wherever
your data already are.

    raw files ──> [1] xcms ──> feature table ──> [2] MS1Match ──> anno_result ──> [3] evaluate a grouping tool
                  (optional)                     (StM14 / SuperPool)              (CAMERA, RAMClustR, any tool)

| \# | Tutorial | What it covers | Start here if you have |
|----|----|----|----|
| 1 | [Preprocessing with xcms](https://RuibingS.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/articles/01_preprocessing_xcms.html) | Peak picking, alignment and correspondence ([`runxcmsFT()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/runxcmsFT.md) or step by step); export of the feature table | Raw `.mzML` / `.mzXML` files |
| 2a | [MS1Match workflow: StM14](https://RuibingS.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/articles/02a_ms1match_StM14.html) | **Main tutorial.** 14 standards spiked into a *P. aeruginosa* extract, MS1 + MS2: consensus MS2 spectra, direct library match, Phase 1 / Phase 2 annotation, in-source fragments, tier summary, export | An xcms feature table |
| 2b | [MS1Match workflow: SuperPool](https://RuibingS.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/articles/02b_ms1match_SuperPool.html) | The same workflow on a pooled sample of MSMLS standards and a larger in-house library | An xcms feature table (larger example) |
| 2c | [Other inputs: MZmine, CSV, no MS2](https://RuibingS.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/articles/02c_ms1match_other_inputs.html) | MS1Match on an MZmine full feature table ([`read_mzmine_feature_table()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/read_mzmine_feature_table.md)) or any CSV ([`read_feature_table()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/read_feature_table.md)), without MS2; evaluating MZmine’s own groupings | A feature table from MZmine or other software |
| 3 | [Evaluate a grouping tool](https://RuibingS.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/articles/03_evaluate_grouping_tools.html) | Benchmarking CAMERA, RAMClustR, MZmine or any other tool against the MS1Match reference set: standard grouping table, same-feature-table check, tier-stratified results | An `anno_result` and a grouping result from the same feature table |

After installation, the same tutorials are available offline:

``` r

browseVignettes("MS1Match")
vignette("02a_ms1match_StM14", package = "MS1Match")
```

### Which path do I follow?

- **Starting from raw files:** 1 → 2a → (3)
- **Feature table from xcms:** 2a → (3)
- **Feature table from MZmine, MS-DIAL or a CSV:** 2c → (3)
- **Benchmarking a grouping tool and you already have `anno_result`:** 3
  only

Tutorial 3 never runs MS1Match itself. It reuses the `anno_result` and
the feature table from tutorial 2, so the grouping tool must have been
run on **the same feature table**. Tutorial 3 shows how to check this.

### Example data

All tutorials run on example data shipped in `inst/extdata`. Slow steps
(peak picking, MS2 consensus building) are loaded from cached `.rds`
files; the code to recompute them from raw files is included but not
run.

| Dataset | Content | Library |
|----|----|----|
| StM14 | 14 standards spiked into a *P. aeruginosa* metabolome extract at three concentrations, MS1 + DDA MS2 | Si14 (14 compounds) |
| StM14 (MZmine) | The same samples processed with MZmine 3: full feature table of the 9 MS1 files, with MZmine’s correlation groups and ion identity networks | Si14 (14 compounds) |
| SuperPool | Pooled MSMLS standards, MS1 + DDA MS2 | CBIO in-house library, restricted to the pool’s targets |

# Analyses for the manuscript

The `analysis/` folder holds the full benchmark analyses reported in the
manuscript: CAMERA and RAMClustR evaluations on StM14 and SuperPool. All
Ref-\* counts come from
[`evaluate_grouping()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/evaluate_grouping.md),
the same function as in tutorial 3; the CAMERA files add
adduct-annotation accuracy, confusion analysis and case studies. They
are not built as vignettes. Render them with
[`rmarkdown::render()`](https://pkgs.rstudio.com/rmarkdown/reference/render.html)
after installing the package; the knitted reports are in
`analysis/html/`.

| File | Content |
|----|----|
| `analysis/StM14_CAMERA_evaluation.Rmd` | CAMERA pcgroups vs. the MS1Match reference set: tier benchmark, pcgroup purity, adduct annotation coverage / accuracy, failure-cause analysis, compound case studies |
| `analysis/StM14_RAMClustR_evaluation.Rmd` | The same grouping evaluation for RAMClustR, with coverage and cluster purity per compound |
| `analysis/SuperPool_CAMERA_evaluation.Rmd` | The CAMERA evaluation on SuperPool |
| `analysis/SuperPool_RAMClustR_evaluation.Rmd` | The RAMClustR evaluation on SuperPool |

# Citation

If you use MS1Match, please cite: *(manuscript in preparation)*.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`annotateISF(`*`<PeakAnnotationISF>`*`)`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/annotateISF-PeakAnnotationISF-method.md)
  : Annotate features as MS2 fragment ions (Tier 1c / 1c_exp)
- [`annotateLibMatch(`*`<PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch>`*`)`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/annotateLibMatch-PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch-method.md)
  : Annotate features from spectral library match results
- [`annotateLibMatch()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/annotateLibMatch.md)
  : Annotate peaks
- [`annotations_df()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/annotations_df.md)
  : Flatten annotate result (PeakAnnotation) to a data.frame
- [`assign_feature_names()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/assign_feature_names.md)
  : Give a grouping result the feature ids of the MS1Match feature table
- [`buildFeatureTable()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/buildFeatureTable.md)
  : Build simple feature table
- [`build_anchors()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_anchors.md)
  : Define the M+H+ anchor feature for each compound instance
- [`build_annot_lookup()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_annot_lookup.md)
  : Build a per-feature annotation lookup table
- [`build_anno_accuracy()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_anno_accuracy.md)
  : Assess Tier 1a adduct annotation accuracy
- [`build_benchmark_table()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_benchmark_table.md)
  : Build the tier-stratified benchmark summary table
- [`build_benchmark_table_from_full()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_benchmark_table_from_full.md)
  : Recompute the tier-stratified benchmark table from
  build_full_feature_table()
- [`build_compound_eval()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_compound_eval.md)
  : Build the per-compound tier-wise grouping recall table
- [`build_compound_instance_table()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_compound_instance_table.md)
  : Build a flat, all-compounds feature table with CAMERA grouping
  context
- [`build_eval_full()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_eval_full.md)
  : Build the feature × compound evaluation table
- [`build_full_feature_table()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_full_feature_table.md)
  : Build the complete CAMERA feature table with reference-relative
  status
- [`build_log10_yaxis()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_log10_yaxis.md)
  : Build y-axis breaks and labels for the log10(x+1) intensity scale
- [`build_mirror_df()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_mirror_df.md)
  : Build the mirror plot data frame for one spectrum pair
- [`build_pcgroup_purity()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_pcgroup_purity.md)
  : Assess CAMERA pcgroup purity (over-grouping)
- [`build_plot2_data()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_plot2_data.md)
  : Build per-pcgroup purity summary for the over-grouping scatter plot
- [`build_query_label()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/build_query_label.md)
  : Build the label string for a single query peak
- [`calculate_exact_mass()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/calculate_exact_mass.md)
  : Calculate monoisotopic exact mass from molecular formulae
- [`camera_to_grouping()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/camera_to_grouping.md)
  : Grouping table from a CAMERA peak list
- [`check_feature_match()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/check_feature_match.md)
  : Check that MS1Match and a grouping tool used the same feature table
- [`classify_ref_status()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/classify_ref_status.md)
  : Classify features by reference-relative evaluation status
- [`compare_grouping()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/compare_grouping.md)
  : Compare several grouping evaluations side by side
- [`compounds()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/compounds.md)
  : Access library compounds
- [`compute_xlim()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/compute_xlim.md)
  : Compute a shared x-axis range for the MS1 + MS2 mirror plot pair
- [`convert_to_nist_msp()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/convert_to_nist_msp.md)
  : Convert a parsed library to standard NIST MSP format
- [`createDirectLibMatch()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/createDirectLibMatch.md)
  : Create a DirectLibMatch object
- [`createDirectTargetMatch()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/createDirectTargetMatch.md)
  : Create a DirectTargetMatch object
- [`createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch.md)
  : Create a PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch object
- [`createPeakAnnotationISF()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/createPeakAnnotationISF.md)
  : Create a PeakAnnotationISF object
- [`DirectLibMatch-class`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/DirectLibMatch-class.md)
  : Class for Direct Library Matching
- [`DirectTargetMatch-class`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/DirectTargetMatch-class.md)
  : Class for Direct Target Matching
- [`.strip_one_adduct()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/dot-strip_one_adduct.md)
  : Strip trailing mass value from a single adduct token
- [`evaluate_grouping()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/evaluate_grouping.md)
  : Evaluate a feature-grouping tool against the MS1Match reference set
- [`exportFeatureTable()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/exportFeatureTable.md)
  : Export feature table to CSV
- [`export_mirror_plots()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/export_mirror_plots.md)
  : Batch-export mirror plots for all compounds in a direct_match list
- [`export_msp()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/export_msp.md)
  : Export a compound library list to NIST MSP format
- [`extract_nl_label_from_adduct()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/extract_nl_label_from_adduct.md)
  : Extract a clean neutral-loss label from a pipeline adduct_match
  string
- [`extract_precursor_mz()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/extract_precursor_mz.md)
  : Extract precursor m/z from a direct_match entry
- [`features()`](https://ruibings.github.io/MS1Match_Rpackage/reference/features.md)
  : Access features data
